name: HDR Control
description: Makes a chosen color profile the primary display's HDR profile while a client streams in HDR, then puts back the previous profile when the application quits. Pick a profile made with the Windows HDR Calibration app, or any other installed HDR profile.
author: Sunshine

options.label: HDR profile
options.description: Color profile the primary display uses in HDR mode during the stream. Profiles already linked to the display are listed first. Override it for an application or a client to give each its own.

options.label: Wait for HDR mode (seconds)
options.description: How long to wait for the display to switch to HDR mode before leaving its profile as it is.

options.label: Put back the previous profile
options.description: When the application quits, make the display's previous HDR profile its HDR profile again and unlink any profile the plugin linked. Turn this off to keep the stream's profile.
